import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static long N, K;
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
    static long[] Power = new long[65];
    static long[][] Res = new long[35][35];
    static long[][][][] S = new long[65][35][35][35];
    static long[][][][] A = new long[65][35][35][35];
    static long[][][][] P = new long[65][35][35][35];
    static long[][] Aux = new long[35][35];

    static void addMod(long[] a, long b) {
        a[0] = (a[0] + b) % MOD;
    }

    static void copyMatrix(long[][] dest, long[][] src, long n) {
        for (long i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (long j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                dest[(int)i][(int)j] = src[(int)i][(int)j];
            }
        }
    }

    static void matrixMultiply(long[][] X, long[][] Y, long[][] Z, long n, long m, long p) {
        for (long i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (long j = 0; j < p; ++j) {
                Z[(int)i][(int)j] = 0;
                for (long k = 0; k < m; ++k) {
                    long product = (X[(int)i][(int)k] * Y[(int)k][(int)j]) % MOD;
                    Z[(int)i][(int)j] = (Z[(int)i][(int)j] + product) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void precomputeA() {
        for (long x = 0; x < K; ++x) {
            for (long i = 0; i < K + 1; ++i) {
                A[0][(int)x][(int)i][(int)i] = 1;
            }
            for (long j = 0; j < K + 1; ++j) {
                A[0][(int)x][(int)j][(int)x] = 1;
            }
        }

        copyMatrix(P[0][0], A[0][0], K + 1);
        copyMatrix(S[0][(int)(K - 1)], A[0][(int)(K - 1)], K + 1);

        for (long x = 1; x < K; ++x) {
            matrixMultiply(P[0][(int)(x - 1)], A[0][(int)x], P[0][(int)x], K + 1, K + 1, K + 1);
        }

        for (long x = K - 2; x >= 0; --x) {
            matrixMultiply(A[0][(int)x], S[0][(int)(x + 1)], S[0][(int)x], K + 1, K + 1, K + 1);
        }

        long multiplier = 1;
        int level = 0;
        while (multiplier <= N / K) {
            for (long x = 0; x < K; ++x) {
                if (x > 0) {
                    copyMatrix(A[level][(int)x], S[level - 1][(int)x], K + 1);
                    matrixMultiply(A[level][(int)x], P[level - 1][(int)(x - 1)], Aux, K + 1, K + 1, K + 1);
                    copyMatrix(A[level][(int)x], Aux, K + 1);
                } else {
                    copyMatrix(A[level][(int)x], S[level - 1][(int)x], K + 1);
                }
            }
            copyMatrix(P[level][0], A[level][0], K + 1);
            copyMatrix(S[level][(int)(K - 1)], A[level][(int)(K - 1)], K + 1);

            for (long x = 1; x < K; ++x) {
                matrixMultiply(P[level][(int)(x - 1)], A[level][(int)x], P[level][(int)x], K + 1, K + 1, K + 1);
            }

            for (long x = K - 2; x >= 0; --x) {
                matrixMultiply(A[level][(int)x], S[level][(int)(x + 1)], S[level][(int)x], K + 1, K + 1, K + 1);
            }

            if (multiplier > N / K / K) break;
            multiplier *= K;
            ++level;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        N = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        K = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());

        Power[0] = 1;
        int powerIndex = 1;
        while (Power[powerIndex - 1] <= N / K) {
            Power[powerIndex] = Power[powerIndex - 1] * K;
            ++powerIndex;
        }

        int maxPowerIndex = powerIndex - 1;
        precomputeA();

        long remaining = N;
        int digitIndex = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= K; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j <= K; ++j)
                Res[i][j] = 0;
        Res[0][K] = 1;

        for (int p = maxPowerIndex; p >= 0; --p) {
            while (Power[p] <= remaining) {
                for (int i = 0; i <= K; ++i) {
                    for (int j = 0; j <= K; ++j) {
                        Aux[i][j] = 0;
                        for (int k = 0; k <= K; ++k) {
                            long product = (Res[i][k] * A[p][digitIndex][k][j]) % MOD;
                            Aux[i][j] = (Aux[i][j] + product) % MOD;
                        }
                    }
                }
                for (int i = 0; i <= K; ++i)
                    for (int j = 0; j <= K; ++j)
                        Res[i][j] = Aux[i][j];
                digitIndex = (digitIndex + 1) % K;
                remaining -= Power[p];
            }
        }

        long answer = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= K; ++i) {
            answer = (answer + Res[0][i]) % MOD;
        }
        System.out.println(answer);
    }
}
